name: Tennille Inc.

hero.title: Opened in 1904 as a roofing company.
hero.lead: Tennille Inc. is an industrial metal fabricator in Texas City, Texas, serving the petrochemical industry with welding, cutting, rolling and forming.
hero.titleAccent: Now we fabricate metal for industry.

highlights.title: 117 years in business
highlights.text: We opened in 1904 and plan to be here for our customers in the future.

highlights.title: Emergency turnaround
highlights.text: We offer 24-hour, 365-day standard and emergency turnaround service.

highlights.title: No job too small
highlights.text: Every job is valued, whatever its size.

summary: Tennille Inc. offers welding, plasma cutting and plate rolling from Texas City, Texas.

groups.title: Welding
groups.summary: We employ highly trained and experienced tradesman capable of welding carbon steel.
groups.intro: We employ highly trained and experienced tradesman capable of welding carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, inconel, hastelloy, titanium, and other exotic metals.

groups.title: Industrial Metal Fabrication
groups.summary: In today’s industrial and petrochemical market, fast-paced turnaround and innovation is the norm.
groups.intro: In today’s industrial and petrochemical market, fast-paced turnaround and innovation is the norm. Due to rapid increases in technology and demand, these markets require a company that can provide the knowledge and quality of service to “GET THE JOB DONE!”

groups.title: Custom Fabrication
groups.summary: We cut, roll, press, punch and weld metal in our own shop, so a custom job can move from raw plate and beams to finished parts in one place.
groups.intro: We cut, roll, press, punch and weld metal in our own shop, so a custom job can move from raw plate and beams to finished parts in one place.

about.title: A Texas City company since 1904
text: In 1904 we opened our doors in Texas City to serve the community as a roofing company, and in the years after we moved into the industrial market.
Raymond F. Guidry, Jr. took the helm in 1985, and under his guidance we have grown into an industrial metal fabricator for the petrochemical industry.
We employ a highly trained and innovative staff to solve problems, and we have built our reputation on quality, cost efficiency and customer service.
